evidence_record.description: Built by build_evidence_record() and written BEFORE any scoring. All 60 keys are always present; fields that do not apply to the run are null or empty, never absent.

auth_bootstrap.description: Per-side auth bootstrap summary, e.g. {"fix": {"generated": ["ADMIN_EMAIL", "ADMIN_PASSWORD"]}}: env NAMES recorded as "generated", never their values.

author_prompt_builder_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the prompt builder module.

author_prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the frozen author-prompt template that built the prompt.

b_sha.description: The bug-introducing commit B, resolved separately from fix^; recorded for provenance.

c_provision.description: Provisioning result for the C side (provisioning contract, not this contract).

c_sha.description: The clean-diff commit C; only clean runs use the c_* fields.

captured_values.description: Values captured during the run. Stored REDACTED (see the contract doc): the written record holds redaction markers, not the values. A name bound more than once maps to a list of its distinct values.

container_env_keys.description: D220 (1.8.0): the contract env key NAMES the run's sandbox install and app containers received — names only, never values. The contract's full env key set on the contract-store (measured) path; the declared-public subset on paths that filter. Empty when no container was provisioned.

author_evidence.description: D242 (1.9.0, R-METHOD): how the final author answer came about — {correction_used, correction_prompt_sha256, correction_call_attempts, correction_call_error, final_answer (first|second), first_answer and second_answer ({content, sha256, finish_reason, usage, request}; second null when no correction answer was used), checks ({r1, r2}: per assertion {probe, assertion, type, result} with result ok or an evidence_* rejection; r2 null when none)}. Null when the evidence check did not run (no author answer). Recorded, never scored.

contract_env.description: Contract env values used by the run; same redaction rule as fixture, via public_contract_env_keys.

contract_source.description: WO-1.14 (REG-E): where the measured unit's contract was loaded from — {store_path, sha256}: the committed contract store path relative to the ProofDeploy tree and that file's sha256. sha256 is null when the store file could not be read (a contract refusal record); the whole field is null on paths that do not load a contract from the store.

crash_probe_results.description: Crash records only: whatever per-probe results were gathered before the crash. The builder types this Any; no single shape is guaranteed.

dry_run.description: D222 (1.8.0): the dry-run marking. Null on every real run; "provision" on a provision-rehearsal record (bundle assembled and leak-checked, both sides provisioned, the unit's fixed rehearsal probe set run through the real executor with its per-probe results in the per-side result fields, no model call). A rehearsal record is never scored and never counts as a measured result.

fix_parent_sha.description: fix^: the parent of the fix commit; the side the probes run against first.

fix_sha.description: The fix commit in the target repo.

fixture.description: Fixture values used by the run; every value is a redaction secret unless its key is in public_fixture_keys.

harness_version.description: HARNESS_VERSION (the probe-schema harness version), distinct from schema_version.

inconclusive_cause.description: Crash records only: the typed cause of an orchestrator-crash INCONCLUSIVE.

invalid_probe_blocks.description: Author blocks that failed validation, recorded verbatim with their rejection reason ({block_index, raw_text, rejection_reason}).

measured_result.description: False marks a non-measured (e.g. unsandboxed dev) run; such a record must never be treated as a measured result.

minted_tokens.description: Tokens minted by the credential provider. Stored REDACTED, like captured_values.

model_finish_reason.description: The model response's finish reason exactly as returned by the provider (D211); null when the response carried none or no model call completed. Recorded, never scored.

model_request.description: The exact model request as sent (model, temperature, per-message hashes, seed/tools as sent).

model_usage.description: The model response's usage accounting exactly as returned by the provider (D211); null when the response carried none or no model call completed. Recorded, never scored.

parsed_probes.description: The parsed probes, stored VERBATIM and never redacted; parsed_probes_sha256 must still match them.

parsed_probes_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of parsed_probes.

provenance.description: Caller provenance (Actions run URL/ID, runner image, capability probe) merged with the computed harness object, which is always present.

sandbox_evidence.description: Isolation actually in effect per side (network mode, userns mode, uid); empty when the sandbox was not used.

scoring_version.description: The scoring rule version; the only value the code produces is v2-per-probe.

verdict.description: Always null on an evidence record: the verdict lives on the score (and judgment) records, never on the evidence.

write_grants.description: Per side: {provisioned, target_url, network_mode} — writes were allowed on a side iff its executor was provisioned.

harness_provenance.description: provenance.harness, computed by harness_provenance() (proofdeploy/runpair.py): the ProofDeploy code that produced the record.

commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the ProofDeploy checkout; null when the package does not sit at that repo's toplevel. Never sourced from an environment variable.

judgment_record.description: Built by build_judgment_record(): the reviewer's condition-3 decision. Append-only; cites the evidence and score records and the evidence commit.

judge.description: Must be non-empty on bug runs (enforced at write time).

judge_role.description: On measured (bug) runs only "reviewer" may judge (enforced at write time).

probe_index.description: Must be in the cited score's candidate_catch (enforced at write time).

verdict.description: "catch" only when condition3_met is true for the cited probe.

probe_result.description: One per-probe result, as serialized by ProbeResult.to_dict() (proofdeploy/executor.py). Embedded in evidence records under fix_parent_results / fix_results / c_results.

assertions_evaluated.description: Whether assertion evaluation actually ran; when false, replay must carry the recorded verdict instead of re-deciding.

http_body.description: Response body, capped at 2000 characters by ProbeResult.to_dict().

http_body_truncated.description: True when http_body was truncated at the 2000-character cap; a truncated body is not replayable.

reason.description: Typed INCONCLUSIVE reason (InconclusiveReason); null unless verdict is inconclusive.

request.description: The act request actually sent; null when no request was sent.

sent.description: Whether the probe was actually sent to the target.

setup_requests.description: Every setup-step request actually sent, in order; null when the executor left it unset.

record_id.description: uuid.uuid4().hex, minted by the record builder.

recorded_request.description: An HTTP request exactly as sent, recorded by the executor for replay: {method, url, headers, body}.

body.description: Request body as sent; any JSON value or null.

score_record.description: Built by build_score_record() from the COMMITTED evidence record; caller-passed verdicts that disagree with the evidence are refused. Written in a later commit than the evidence it cites.

candidate_catch.description: Indices of EVERY probe that went FAIL on fix^ and PASS on fix.

evidence_commit_sha.description: The git commit that carries the cited evidence record.

false_alarm.description: Clean runs only; null on bug runs.

verdict.description: Bug runs: candidate_catch (never "catch" — only a judgment makes a catch), no_catch, or inconclusive. Clean runs: null; they score false_alarm instead.

sha256_hex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest as produced by hashlib.sha256(...).hexdigest().

description: The record format written to runs.jsonl by proofdeploy/runpair.py at SCHEMA_VERSION 1.9.0 (proofdeploy/probe.py). One JSON object per line; exactly three record types: evidence, score, judgment. This schema uses only the keyword subset enforced by the stdlib validator in tests/test_runpair.py (type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, pattern, oneOf, anyOf, $defs/$ref); every other keyword is annotation only. See docs/contract/result-contract.md for the prose contract.
title: ProofDeploy result record, schema_version 1.9.0
